name: Colorado Department of Revenue - Taxation (individual income tax)
notes: Researched from public tax.colorado.gov pages only. Revenue Online: Make a Payment under Payment Options without login (ID type CAN/SSN/ITIN, filing period 12/31/<year>, payment type Bill Payment), card or e-check through the Colorado.gov secured payment process. Fees charged to the taxpayer: e-check $1.00; card (amount + $0.75) x 2.25% (modelled as 2.25%; the 75-cent base adds under 2 cents). Logged-in Revenue Online: records, secure messages, payment plan requests, manage payments and returns. Payment plans: no fee, up to 36 months (non-business), amounts under $50 or two months of installments must be paid in full, signed agreement within 30 days waives the collection statute; Collections 303-205-8291. No recurring AutoPay for balances (inferred). Sign-in by username inferred.

guest_pay.note: Make a Payment in Revenue Online without logging in, using your Colorado Account Number, SSN or ITIN.

autopay.note: Revenue Online has no recurring automatic payments for income tax balances. Make each payment yourself, or request a payment plan if you cannot pay in full.

payment_arrangement.note: Payment plans have no added fee, but penalties and interest keep accruing. Balances under $50 must be paid in full.

notes: The card fee is 2.25% of the amount due plus 75 cents, that is (amount due + $0.75) x 2.25%.

help.title: Pay by credit/debit card or e-check
paragraphs: You do not need a Revenue Online login to pay. Use Make a Payment in the Payment Options box, choose Debit or Credit Card or E-Check, enter your taxpayer information and add the payment: account type Individual Income Tax, your ID (Colorado Account Number, SSN or ITIN), the filing period (December 31 of the tax year) and the payment type, usually Bill Payment.

Processing fees are charged to you and added to the total automatically: an e-check costs $1.00, and a card payment costs 2.25% of the amount due plus 75 cents, calculated as (amount due + $0.75) x 2.25%. Enter only the tax amount; the fee is added for you.
To pay by check, include the DR 0900 voucher, make the check payable to the Colorado Department of Revenue and write your SSN, the tax year and Form 104 on it.

help.title: Payment plans for individuals
paragraphs: If you cannot pay your Colorado tax debt in full, log in to Revenue Online to request a payment plan, or call the Collections Section at 303-205-8291. For current-year income tax, wait until after April 15 to call.

There is no fee to join a plan, but late-payment penalties apply and interest accrues until the balance is paid. Standard plans for individuals run up to 36 months. You cannot get a plan if the debt was referred to a collection agency or you are under a wage levy or garnishment.

Sign and return the installment agreement within 30 days; it waives the statute of limitations for collecting the debt. Missing a payment, a returned payment, or not filing and paying future returns on time makes the whole balance due at once.

help.title: Small balances and duplicate payments
paragraphs: If you owe less than $50, or the balance would be paid off in two monthly installments, pay it in full; a payment plan is not available.

Not sure a payment went through? Do not pay again, because a second payment will also process. Send a secure message in Revenue Online or contact the Department; payments show up in a few business days.
